athlete.bio: A tenacious middle blocker, she combines agility and power with a fierce competitive spirit. Known for her strategic instincts on the court, she inspires teammates with her relentless drive and positivity.

caption:
Two years ago, I entered the portal never wanting to play volleyball again. I was unsure of myself and thought the best option was to walk away from the game I loved. Looking back now, I am simply in awe of Gods work and the path he set for me. 

I’m beyond blessed to have been apart of this program and community here at K-State. Thank you to my amazing parents and family for being the light through a lot of dark days. Without your support this wouldn’t be possible. To my teammates and staff, you all have changed me for the better. With every doubt you guys showed me that I deserve to be here, and I will forever be grateful.

There will never be enough words to describe how thankful I am for these past two years. I’m forever proud to be a Kansas State Wildcat.💜

caption:
thank you kstate 
you allowed me to fall back in love with a game i had lost passion for. to my very best friends, thank you for making the hard days easy and for the never-ending support you always showed me. thank you for allowing me into your hearts, and making a difference in mine. 
to the coaches, thank you for always believing in me, even when i didn’t believe in myself. my four years at kstate taught me a lot, but most importantly it brought me people i will remember forever

caption: Let me start by saying, All glory to God. If I could go back and change anything in this past three years, I wouldn’t change a single thing. I truly thank God for the women I have meet through this program. I have been blessed with best friends and memories that will last a lifetime. Without them I wouldn’t be the person I am today. Manhattan is always going to be a special place for me. Thank you to my coaches who constantly worked with me and pushing me to be better. I am beyond grateful for the people I have met here, K-State will always be like a home. But, with that being said it’s time for this chapter of life to come to a close 💜 God has more in store for me and I can’t wait to see what’s next! Truly grateful for everyone here.

caption:
Das hier heute ist vermutlich mein emotionalster Post den ich bis jetzt gemacht habe. Ich sage nach 14 Jahren aufwiedersehen zu meinem Heimatverein. Der erste und einzige für den ich bis jetzt mein Leben lang gespielt habe. Ich schaue mir die Bilder mit einem weinenden aber auch einem lachenden Auge an. Es ist traurig das ist jetzt vorbei ist aber so schön das es passiert ist. So viele tolle Erinnerungen, Erlebnisse und Menschen die ich kennenlernen durfte. Angefangen mit 7 in der U9 und alle Jugend Teams durchlaufen bis zu den Profis. Damit hab ich mir einen Traum erfüllt von dem viele nie gedacht hätten das er war wird. Ich habe bei diesem Verein nicht nur sportliche Erfolge erzielt mit gewonnen Meisterschaften, wie zum Beispiel die U14 oder zweimal die U19 Deutsche Meisterschaft sondern viel wichtiger habe ich ein zu Hause und eine Familie gefunden. Einige mit denen ich damals zusammen gespielt habe sind bis heute meine engsten Freunde auch obwohl wir schon seit Jahren nicht mehr zusammen spielen. Ich möchte mich einmal von ganzen Herzen bedanken für alle die mich auf meinem Weg begleitet und unterstützt haben, danke an alle Trainer die wegen mir ein paar mehr graue Haare haben, an alle Mitarbeiter von Alba die uns Spielern jeden Tag alles organisieren und es uns ermöglichen unseren Job zu machen und uns nur auf Basketball zu konzentrieren, danke an alle meine Spieler egal ob in der Jugend oder bei den Profis für die tollen Zeiten und was ihr mir mitgegeben habt und danke an die Fans die uns so krass unterstützten. Das Gefühl das ihr einem Gebt ist unglaublich, jedes Mal werde ich nach dem Spiel angesprochen wie gut ich gespielt habe, was ich für eine tolle Entwicklung gemacht habe und dieses Lob oder die Anerkennung von euch zubekommen hat mich sehr gepusht und mir sehr viel bedeutet. 
Vielen Dank Alba Berlin euer Elias💛💙

This Friday against Olathe North will be our cancer awareness game in support of the crucial catch initiative. 
This year however, we have someone close to our program that needs our help. Lisa Bergeron, mother of 2022 Senior and current K-State Safety Mikey Bergeron, has been diagnosed with Metastatic Melanoma. As a community, we want to rally behind Lisa and help her in any way that we can. A fund has been set up to help the Bergeron family and Lisa’s fight against cancer, and any donations would be greatly appreciated. All proceeds will go to the cause. 
If you wish to donate, either scan the QR code on the post with another device, or go to @jag_pac_inc on Venmo to send in your donations!!
Lisa is one of the strongest people we know and she will continue to fight through this courageous battle!! 
#1-0

caption:
To be able to walk away from a severe wreck like this without even so much as a scratch on me is proof that GOD is present at all times. Thursday morning around 7:15am was probably the scariest moment of my life and all I can do is thank God that I was able to walk away healthy. I was ran off the road and went head on into a wall. That truck has been through 3 generations starting with my grandma, then my dad, and ending with me. Everyone knows how much I loved that truck and I will never forget the memories that were made in it. Thursday showed me how things can happen in the blink of an eye, but also that life is precious and it shouldn’t be taken for granted. God’s timing is the best, and it wasn’t my time yet🙏🏾. I cannot thank HIM enough for wrapping his arm around me that morning and protecting me through what couldn’t have gone so much worse. I want to thank everyone for all the love and support you’ve shown me❤️. Love you all 
#imstillstanding 

Sincerely,
TheChosen1
